# Move both neo-agent-skills pins to 0.1.15

## Context

`neo-agent-skills` 0.1.15 is published: neomjs/neo-agent-skills#106 merged, and the operator published it on 2026-09-23. The registry serves it (HTTP 200 on `/neo-agent-skills/0.1.15`).

It carries release-notes §2's corpus recipe. The 13.2 notes surveys (#19098–#19102) count their windows with that recipe, but this repository still materializes 0.1.14.

## The Problem

The two pins that #19036 moved to 0.1.14 still point there:
- `package.json` `devDependencies.neo-agent-skills` is `0.1.14`, so `.agents/skills/release-notes` here still tells authors to count from the frozen `resources/content`;
- `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml:73` references the reusable workflow at `10b7add57f…`, whose `SKILLS_VERSION` steps install 0.1.14.

## The Fix

Same shape as #19036:
- the dependency moves to `0.1.15`, with the lockfile regenerated;
- the workflow reference moves to `neomjs/neo-agent-skills@fe1a9434163eb17d422216f40fd39785b0bda917`, the #106 merge, whose six `SKILLS_VERSION` pins are `0.1.15`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 `node_modules/neo-agent-skills/package.json` reports 0.1.15, and `.agents/skills/release-notes/references/release-notes-workflow.md` carries the corpus recipe.
- [ ] AC-2 `pr-baseline.yml` references `fe1a9434163e…`, and the PR's `baseline` jobs install 0.1.15 and pass.

## Out of Scope

- 0.1.16 (neomjs/neo-agent-skills#108, not yet merged). It gets its own bump when published.

## Related

#19036 (the 0.1.14 precedent) · neomjs/neo-agent-skills#104 / #106 · #14800
